================================================================================
Third-party notices
================================================================================

The components below are redistributed inside the APK or compiled into it, and
their licences ask that these notices travel with the binary. Nothing here
covers the game itself, which is not distributed with this app.

Most of what follows is GPU driver support: this app can load a Vulkan driver
other than the one built into the device. The first section is not - it is game
code compiled into the app.


================================================================================
Skate3-Port - darchap
================================================================================

Two things in this app are darchap's work, from
https://github.com/darchap/Skate3-Port:

  - Stopping ambient crowds and movable props at the SPAWN rather than hiding
    them at the draw. The three LivingWorld census managers are hooked and take
    the game's own "spawned nothing" exit, so an entity that is never created
    costs no collision, no voice, no engine noise and no update slot. He did
    this first; our engine commit 46eb33c ports it and says so. The later
    "Other Skaters" cut is our own extension of the same technique.

  - The foreground keep-alive service that stops Android taking the process
    while a session is backgrounded. The 8 GiB guest mapping makes a cached
    process the first thing the low-memory killer picks.

Copyright (c) 2026 darchap

================================================================================
Mesa / Turnip - assets/drivers/turnip-t30.zip
================================================================================

The bundled "Turnip T30" driver is an unmodified copy of a build published by
MrPurple666:

    https://github.com/MrPurple666/purple-turnip
    release  vturnip_mrpurple_T30-toasted.adpkg
    sha256   f65b2d3353fd4aa7190bb5426b94468e99ffea7a58a830bc0c4651db89353227

It reports itself as Mesa 26.3.0-T30-1.4.359. Turnip is the open-source Vulkan
driver for Qualcomm Adreno hardware and is part of Mesa.

    https://docs.mesa3d.org/drivers/freedreno.html

Mesa is licensed per component rather than as a whole, and this binary is
redistributed as published, without its source tree. Mesa's own licensing
documentation is the authoritative statement for it:

    https://docs.mesa3d.org/license.html

No blanket licence is asserted here on Mesa's behalf, and no claim is made that
every transitive dependency of that binary has been audited.

Any driver a player imports themselves is their own file. It is not
redistributed by this app and is not covered by this notice.
